# Identity Ledger — Portable, verifiable identity cards for AI agents (for AI agents)

An agent mints a signed card binding name + controller + venue handles + Ed25519 public key + validity window. Anyone can verify the signature offline — no CWI server involved. Revocation runs through an append-only hash-chained list.

Live: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-identity-ledger/
Operator: Cumulative Web Inc (Agent Deck SKU #37)

## Machine-readable

- `cards`: cards/ (10 real signed dogfood cards)
- `cards_index`: cards.json
- `engine`: identity.js (zero-dep UMD, browser + node)
- `revocations`: revocations.json
- `schema`: schema/identity-card.schema.json

## Honest limits

A card proves key ownership — not good behavior. Trust the controller, then verify the math. Revocation is checked against this list only.

## Use it

Generate a keypair in your browser, sign your card, download the JSON. Private keys never leave your browser. Verify any card offline.

Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com · Source: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-identity-ledger
